description: [Signal Desk] The model's term structure for a ticker: the equity indicator's direction from one day out to six months, the curve's shape (strengthening, weakening or flipping), whether the sign changes across horizons, and near/mid/long summary legs, each marked `mixed` when its points lean both ways. Carries no drivers or track record; those are on the signal card. Past curves are stored daily from about May 2024, and the result carries the snapshot date served. Available on fAlpha Professional, Premium and Enterprise plans.

as_of_date.description: Date, YYYY-MM-DD. Without it, the latest reading is returned.
as_of_date.title: As Of Date

regime.description: Market backdrop the model conditions on: neutral (no market view), bull or bear.
regime.title: Regime

ticker.description: US-listed equity symbol in fAlpha's covered universe, e.g. NVDA. falpha_screener_desk_coverage reports whether a symbol is covered.
ticker.title: Ticker
